description: Free: does this x402 endpoint work for a paying agent? Returns pass, warn or fail with the number of problems and the top three. Limited to 10 calls per hour. For every check use x402_diagnose ($0.01); for code changes x402_fix ($0.05); before paying someone else's endpoint x402_preflight ($0.001).
